full_prompt_en: A close black-and-white photographic portrait shows a woman standing near a window with horizontal blinds. Her dark hair and clothing recede into the nearly black left and lower edges, while her face occupies the central portion of a tight square frame. Daylight passing between the slats lays crisp pale bands across her forehead, eye, nose, cheek, and mouth. Dark bands interrupt those illuminated areas, so the geometry of the window becomes a second visual structure laid over her expression. One eye is sharply readable in a bright interval and looks steadily toward the camera; the other side of her face stays partly hidden by hair and darkness. On the right edge, the same striped light appears on the pale wall, making its source understandable without showing the blinds themselves. The photograph is monochrome with cool whites, soft middle grays, and deep charcoal blacks. The bright stripes have clear boundaries but roll gently over the curves of the face. Skin retains subtle grain and tonal variation; hair is more diffuse and absorbs light. The frame crops close enough that setting, costume, and gesture become secondary to the meeting of light and form. Parallel horizontal marks create a measured rhythm against the irregular outline of hair and face. The quiet gaze steadies an otherwise dramatic high-contrast pattern, giving the image both intimate presence and graphic abstraction.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅近距离黑白摄影肖像呈现女子站在带水平百叶的窗旁。深发和衣服退入画框左侧与底部近黑边缘，脸占据紧凑方幅的中央。穿过叶片间隙的日光在额头、眼、鼻、面颊和嘴上铺下清晰浅色条带。暗带切断这些亮部，使窗的几何成为叠在表情上的第二视觉结构。一只眼睛在亮色间隔中清楚可读，稳定地看向镜头；脸的另一侧部分藏在发与暗处。右边缘，同样的条纹光落在浅墙上，不必展示百叶本身也让光源可理解。照片是单色的，具有冷白、柔和中灰和深炭黑。亮条带边界清楚，却顺着面部曲面柔和转折。皮肤保留细微颗粒与调子变化；头发更柔散且吸收光。画框贴近截取，让环境、服装和动作退居光与形相遇之后。平行水平标记对着发和脸的不规则轮廓形成有分寸的节奏。安静目光稳住原本戏剧性的高反差图案，使图像同时具亲密存在感和图形抽象性。
style_prompt_en: High-contrast monochrome photography is organized by parallel bars of directional light alternating with deep shadow. Cool white highlights, middle gray halftones, and charcoal black provide the entire palette. The light bands remain crisp at their edges yet bend gently across curved surfaces, preserving volume beneath their graphic pattern. Fine tonal grain and slight softness in dark regions keep the image photographic. A tight crop concentrates attention on the intersection of repeated horizontal geometry and irregular organic contours, while a small pale side area echoes the rhythm. One bright focal interval holds the clearest detail; adjacent dark strips conceal portions of the form. Large black fields frame the lit pattern and keep the composition calm despite strong contrast. The result is intimate, restrained, and visually rhythmic, with the external light structure becoming part of the image rather than background decoration.
style_prompt_zh: 高反差单色摄影由定向光的平行条带与深影交替组织。冷白亮部、中灰半调和炭黑构成全部配色。光条边界清晰，却随曲面柔和弯折，在图形化图案下保留体积。细微调子颗粒和暗区的轻柔质感使图像保持摄影性。紧裁幅把注意力集中于重复水平几何与不规则有机轮廓的交会，小片侧边浅色区域回响这个节奏。一个明亮焦点间隔承载最清楚的细节，邻近暗条遮住部分形体。大片黑色场域框住光纹，使构图虽高反差仍然平静。结果亲密、克制且有视觉韵律，外来的光结构成为图像的一部分，而非背景装饰。
theme_en: A woman beside a window looks through alternating bands of light and shadow
theme_zh: 女子在窗旁透过交替的明暗条带望来
name: Portrait shot with light and shadow from window blinds
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
